producer.behavior: _search_apt_packages_full_metadata emits discovery_source=APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN and binding_kind=apt for Debian APT candidates

router.behavior: _discovery_supplier_order already prefers candidate.binding_kind before discovery_source and maps apt to apt_cli

consumer.behavior: _viable_candidates rejects every candidate whose discovery_source is not exactly APT_CATALOG

consequence: The verified supplier-discovery output cannot enter the existing APT CLI supplier/contract race through _viable_candidates, so downstream contract-learning evidence is not yet the first blocker.
why_this_is_generic: binding_kind is the existing cross-source routing abstraction and already drives top-level supplier selection; using it removes a stale implementation-source dependency rather than adding an Xapian special case.
